proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous free starting credits (around $10, with FLUX-schnell costing $0.003/image, equaling ~3,000 free images). No credit card required to start.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Fastest API access to FLUX.1 [schnell] and [dev] on the market. Offers optimized latency, built-in upscaling (Lora/ControlNet support), and runs flawlessly via simple HTTP requests from GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Could replace Pollinations inside the `produce_coloring_book` and `produce_kdp_cover` pipelines as the primary high-quality image generator.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once free credits run out, requires Pay-As-You-Go billing, though rates are extremely cheap (much cheaper than Runware's base tier for equivalent speed).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free, no API key required. Rate limits are dictated by Google's standard search rate limits (easily bypassed via GHA rotating runners).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows programmatic, scheduled trend analysis of keywords directly in Python. Can query trending searches, related queries, and interest over time for specific niches (e.g. 'coloring book' trends).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into `agent_trendhunter` or `agent_opportunity_hunter` to automatically discover rising search terms before designing new books/assets.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Since it is an unofficial API, Google can occasionally block requests (HTTP 429) if triggered too rapidly. Needs careful request staggering inside GHA.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to upload, host, and sell 3D models. Take rate on sales is competitive with Cults3D.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A massive, fast-growing 3D model search engine and community. Hosting parametric STL files (from `produce_stl_parametric`) here taps into a highly active 3D printing community that specifically searches for functional prints.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target distribution platform for the `produce_stl_parametric` output pipeline to diversify away from only using Cults3D.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Highly technical audience; simple low-effort models won't sell. Requires high-quality rendering thumbnails.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free publisher account. Takes a percentage commission on sales (30-35% for exclusive, 45% for non-exclusive). No upfront listing fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The absolute largest marketplace for tabletop RPG assets, fantasy coloring books, maps, card games, and PDF-based game accessories. Customers here are actively looking to buy print-ready PDFs and digital game assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Publishing target for `produce_card_game`, `produce_coloring_book` (fantasy-themed), and `produce_gamedev_asset_pack` (specifically 2D maps and tokens).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict formatting requirements for PDF uploads. Audience demands high-quality, thematic work (fantasy/sci-fi).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free developer account. Allows creating up to 5 stores and publishing unlimited products via API.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows complete programmatic creation of POD products. Hugo can use GHA to generate designs, use the Printify API to create mockups/products (mugs, t-shirts, canvas), and automatically push them to connected shops like Etsy or eBay.
proposals.would_integrate_where: New pipeline: `produce_pod_automation` to automatically push scaling variations of designs (e.g. `produce_tumbler_wraps`) directly into live store drafts.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires connecting a sales channel (like Etsy) which might have listing fees ($0.20 on Etsy per listing). Must be paired with free channels or used carefully.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free developer key with up to 2,000 requests per day. Access to millions of CC0/Creative Commons sound effects.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Enables programmatic searching, filtering, and downloading of high-quality audio files. Perfect for generating curated, themed audio assets for game developers.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrate into `produce_gamedev_asset_pack` to bundle curated, mixed, or converted CC0 sound effect packs (UI sounds, ambient noises, retro synth effects).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Must strictly filter for CC0 (Public Domain) licenses using the API query parameters to ensure 100% legal resale safety.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100 free credits daily (refreshed every 24 hours). FLUX-schnell costs ~0.05 credits per image, allowing ~2,000 free images per day.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides a highly stable, completely free daily allotment for high-end open models (FLUX, SDXL, ControlNet, and vector converters) with direct API access.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can act as a highly reliable, zero-cost secondary fallback or primary engine for `produce_coloring_book` and `produce_svg_pack` pipelines in GHA.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Daily credits do not roll over. Requires managing an API key and handling rate limits if generating high-volume batches simultaneously.
